column1: # Week 1 is warn-only, so nothing is FAIL. Week 3 promotes high-confidence rules (see docs/lab/gating-policy.md).

column3: Timestamp disclosure: noisy on JSON APIs, no security value here
CSP header missing: spec requires helmet CSP default-src self
Cookie without HttpOnly: spec requires HttpOnly sid
Cookie without Secure: spec requires Secure sid
Cookie without SameSite: spec requires SameSite=Strict
Application error disclosure: spec forbids stack traces
